title: Ripple River ABC
hook: Letter by letter, follow where it goes.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: gentle freshwater 3D storybook, lily greens and river blues, friendly wildlife, soft rounded forms, clear isolated subjects

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: quiet observer following a ripple from pond edge into the river
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: flowing memory refrain with gentle rise and fall
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written river-folk verses where two or three neighboring targets can share one rhyme or vowel current before a plain factual line releases the pattern
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: two-beat supportive gap then action tied to swimming, growing, flowing or shape
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 acoustic and pizzicato; chorus adds glockenspiel shimmer; Round 2 leaves woodblock pulse and voice
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: pizzicato ripple followed by one soft bell
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Use one small ripple as the memory metaphor for the whole alphabet: it opens, travels, widens, meets living things and river shapes, then softens without really stopping.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: Flow-language and recurring circular motion bind the lyric: ring, ripple, bend, drift, bank, current, settle. Rhyme comes in short current-clusters and then releases into plain observation like water leaving a pool.
semanticArc: banks and living things interrupt/redirect it
last ring softens and the water continues
